pose_constraints.posture: Strictly vertical 'Pillar' orientation. The body is pointing directly at the camera.
pose_constraints.camera_angle: Ultra-low 'Worm's Eye' view. Looking up at the chest and snout.
pose_constraints.body_logic: The entire 18-foot length of the dinosaur is hidden behind its front shoulders. Width is capped at 260px.
pose_constraints.framing_note: The head is positioned low in the crop, with the armored back and shoulder spikes rising up behind it to fill the vertical space.

character_details.expression: A peaceful, sleepy 'tank' look. Eyes are soft and half-lidded.
character_details.texture: Armor plates rendered like polished river stones—smooth, rounded, and tactile. Color: Mossy slate-grey with cream-colored spikes.
features: Large conical shoulder spikes pointing up and out

environmental_details.ground: Dry, sandy riverbed gravel with light-colored pebbles to bounce light upward.
flora: Low-lying mosses in the bottom corners only.
environmental_details.lighting: High-key 'Top-Down' sun. This creates a bright 'crown' on the armor plates while keeping the face soft and visible.
environmental_details.sky: Bright, hazy blue sky peaking over the 'mountain' of the back.
